counterexample.note: Tick 50 is set in the same bitmap word below tick 100, so the repair falls back to the old search and skips tick 100. The walk gives 1500 - 1000 = 500, but the active liquidity at tick 0 is 0.

summary: Keeps the start tick only when its bitmap bit is set, it is not bit 0, and no lower bit in the same word is set. Otherwise the initialized start tick is still skipped, and an unaligned start that passes the check is itself returned although it is not initialized.
